name: net.wirenook.adventure-tools
description: Laser pointer, megaphone, a flashlight and lantern (as glowing geometry or a real light) and screen-space notices for VRChat avatars; an invisible switch; presence, for game masters and spectators: who sees you and who hears you, decided for each viewer; and a game master's kit: dice, a pause, zone markers, a pointer, a portal and a skeleton key.
